title: `reduceBool` / `native_decide` axiom leakage
summary: The kernel evaluated `Lean.reduceBool` natively but tracked no axiom dependency, so a proof that relied on compiler correctness showed *no* axioms in `#print axioms`. Demonstrated with `IO.getRandomBytes`: the same expression reduced non-deterministically to different `Bool` values, yielding a proof of False with no reported axioms. The fix introduced an explicit `trustCompiler` axiom that `reduceBool`/`reduceNat` depend on, so `#print axioms` reports the dependency. Historical ancestor of lean-0003 along the native_decide bridge.

links.label: mathlib4#2656 (made `IO.RealWorld` opaque to block the concrete exploit)
